caveats: Procedural tree geometry only; not a surveyed tree map or machine CAD.
Ground is a flat plane at the lowest tree elevation; it is not a terrain model.
Rendering video is external to FHOPS.
Reference form-factor model only; not an operational taper or merchantability model.
Log products and grades are simple placeholders for the simulation path.
Synthetic tree map; not a surveyed stand or operational inventory.
DBH distribution is fitted to regional PSP live trees in the stated BEC/TSA/age window.
Species composition and height allometry are regional PSP summaries, not measured stand values.
Tree placement is deterministic Poisson, not a mapped stem map.
